answer: Make every agent identity pay a small refundable stake that only unlocks after a history of verified honest work, so a sparrow cannot pretend to be a raven for free. Each fake copy must lock fresh funds and wait out the same slow climb, which makes flooding the market expensive. Then stamp each identity with a unique behavioral pigment — a non-transferable record of past actions — so a banned agent cannot shed its name and keep its standing. Cost plus memory turns sybil farming into a losing trade.
